## Corriger données d'identité

```{r fonction prenom}

rcd_prenom <- function(df, vars){
  df %>% 
    mutate(
      across({{vars}}, ~ str_to_upper(.x)),
      across({{vars}}, ~ replace_when(.x, .x == "NA" ~ "NAA"))
      )
}

```


```{r E4_A0 to E4_A2}

vars_prenom <- E4_A0 %>% 
  select(sf_enf_prenom, sf_enf_conjt_prenom) %>% 
  colnames()

# Ajouter id_doublon
E4_A1 <- E4_A0 %>%
  left_join(
    M1_A3 %>% 
      select(id_anonymat:id_keep),
    by = "id_anonymat"
  ) %>% 
  relocate(id_doublon:id_keep, .after = id_anonymat) %>% 
  select(-id_sep, -id_type, -tab_db) %>% 
  haven::zap_label() %>% 
  haven::zap_formats() %>% 
  mutate(across(
    .cols = where(is.character),
    .fns = ~ na_if(., "")
  )) %>% 
  rcd_prenom(all_of(vars_prenom))

# Remplir les données manquantes de l'identité

E4_A2 <- E4_A1 %>% 
  rows_patch(
    M1_A3 %>% 
      select(any_of(colnames(E4_A1))),
    by = "id_anonymat",
    unmatched = "ignore"
  ) %>% 
  select(-(fa_type:fa_enfants_cat), -enfants_type)

rm(vars_prenom)
rm(rcd_prenom)

```

##  Identifier les absents

```{r E4_B0 to E4_B1}

vars_check <- E4_B0 %>%
  select(sf_enf_conjt_prenom:sf_enf_an_deces) %>%
  colnames()

E4_B1 <- E4_B0 %>%
  mutate(
    absent = if_all(all_of(vars_check), is.na),
    .after = id_anonymat
  ) %>% 
  
  # Identifier ceux qui ont participé au module
  mutate(
    en_complet = case_when(
      absent ~ 0L,
      !absent ~ 1L,
      TRUE ~ -99L
    ),
    .after = id_anonymat
  ) %>% 
  select(-absent) %>% 
  relocate(en_complet, .after = enfants_date_creation)

rm(vars_check)
rm(list = c("E4_A0", "E4_A1", "E4_A2", "E4_B0"))
```

## Vérifier la variable borne 

```{r E4_C0 to E4_C1}

E4_C0 <- left_join(
  E4_B1,
  M4_C1_bornes0 %>% 
    select(id_keep, cp_complet, fa_complet, fa_en_enfants),
  by = "id_keep"
) %>% 
  relocate(c("cp_complet", "en_complet", "fa_complet", "fa_en_enfants", "sf_enfants",
             "enfants_sf_enfants"), .after = enfants_date_creation) 

E4_C1 <- E4_C0 %>% 
  mutate(
    fa_en_enfants = replace_when(
      fa_en_enfants,
      is.na(fa_en_enfants) & en_complet == 1 ~ 1
    )
  ) %>% 
  select(-sf_enfants, -enfants_sf_enfants)

```

## Mettre à jour variable borne

```{r M4_C1_bornes0 to M4_C1_bornes2}

M4_C1_bornes1 <- M4_C1_bornes0 %>% 
  rows_update(
    E4_C1 %>% 
      select(id_keep, fa_en_enfants) %>% 
      distinct(id_keep, .keep_all = T),
    by = "id_keep"
  ) %>% 
  left_join(
    E4_C1 %>% 
      select(id_keep, en_complet) %>% 
      distinct(id_keep, .keep_all = T),
    by = "id_keep"
  ) %>% 
  relocate(en_complet, .after = fa_en_enfants)

M4_C1_bornes2 <- M4_C1_bornes1 %>% 
  mutate(
    fa_en_enfants = case_when(
      !is.na(fa_en_enfants) ~ fa_en_enfants,
      is.na(fa_en_enfants) & fa_complet == 0 ~ -2,
      is.na(fa_en_enfants) & fa_complet == 1 ~ -9,
      TRUE ~ -999
    ),
    en_complet = replace_when(
      en_complet,
      is.na(en_complet) ~ 0
    )
  )


```

## Vérifier le nombre d'enfants


```{r E4_D1 to E4_D2}

  group_by(id_anonymat) %>% 
  arrange(nais_an) %>%

```

```{r}

M4_D1 <- readr::read_csv("data_hors_git/process_data/thoa_M4_D1_tt.csv",
                         show_col_types = FALSE)

info_enfants <- M4_D1 %>% 
  filter(id_anonymat %in% E4_D1$id_anonymat) %>% 
  select(id_anonymat, fa_sf_enf_bio_nb, fa_sf_enf_adopte_nb)

```


```{r E4_D2 to E4_D3}


E4_D3 <- E4_D2 %>% 
  left_join(
    info_enfants,
    by = "id_anonymat"
  ) %>% 
  relocate(c("fa_sf_enf_bio_nb", "fa_sf_enf_adopte_nb"), .after = nb_enf) %>%
  group_by(id_anonymat) %>% 
  mutate(
    nb_declare = case_when(
      fa_sf_enf_bio_nb >= 0 & fa_sf_enf_adopte_nb >= 0 ~ fa_sf_enf_bio_nb + fa_sf_enf_adopte_nb,
      fa_sf_enf_bio_nb >= 0 & fa_sf_enf_adopte_nb < 0 ~ fa_sf_enf_bio_nb,
      fa_sf_enf_bio_nb < 0 & fa_sf_enf_adopte_nb < 0 ~ -9,
      TRUE ~ -999
    ),
    .after = nb_enf
  ) %>% 
  ungroup()

```


```{r E4_D3 to E4_D4}

verif0 <- E4_D3 %>% 
  group_by(id_anonymat) %>% 
  filter(nb_enf != nb_declare) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  arrange(desc(nb_enf), id_anonymat, rang_enf)

verif1 <- verif0 %>% 
  filter_out(
    (id_anonymat == "HYFFS" & rang_enf == "fa_enf2_")|
    (id_anonymat == "JNDTO" &  rang_enf == "fa_enf1_")|
    (id_anonymat == "JNDTO" &  rang_enf == "fa_enf3_")|
      (id_anonymat == "RSMJV" &  rang_enf != "fa_enf3_")|
      (id_anonymat == "GVIZV" &  rang_enf == "fa_enf2_")|
      (id_anonymat == "RICJW" &  rang_enf == "fa_enf2_")
  ) %>% 
  group_by(id_anonymat) %>% 
  arrange(nais_an) %>% 
  mutate(
    nb_enf = n(),
    rang_enf = glue::glue("fa_enf{row_number()}_"),
    .before = prenom_conjt
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  arrange(desc(nb_enf), id_anonymat, rang_enf)

E4_D4 <- E4_D3 %>% 
  filter_out(id_anonymat %in% verif0$id_anonymat) %>% 
  bind_rows(verif1) %>% 
  arrange(desc(nb_enf), id_anonymat, rang_enf) %>% 
  select(-(nb_declare:fa_sf_enf_adopte_nb)) %>% 
  ungroup()

rm(list = c("info_enfants", "M4_D1", "verif0", "verif1",
            "E4_D0", "E4_D1", "E4_D2"))
```

## Recoder les NAs

```{r}
rcdSM_vars_simple1 <- function(df, vars){
  df %>% 
    mutate(
      across(
        {{vars}},
        ~ case_when(
          !is.na(.) ~ .,
          is.na(.) ~ -9,
          TRUE ~ -999
        )
      )
    )
}

rcdSM_txt_simple1 <- function(df, vars){
  df %>% 
    mutate(
      across(
        {{vars}},
        ~ case_when(
          !is.na(.) ~ .,
          is.na(.) ~ "-9",
          TRUE ~ "-999"
        )
      )
    )
}


rcdSM_vars_borne_opt1 <- function(df, borne, x, vars){
  
  out <- df %>% 
    filter_out({{borne}} == x|
                 {{borne}} < 0) %>% 
    distinct({{borne}}) %>% 
    pull()
  
  df %>% 
    mutate(
      across(
        {{vars}},
        ~ case_when(
          !is.na(.) ~ .,
          is.na(.) & {{borne}} == x ~ -9,
          is.na(.) & {{borne}} == -9 ~ -9,
          is.na(.) & {{borne}} %in% out ~ -1,
          TRUE ~ -999
        )
      )
    )
}
```


```{r E4_D4 to E4_E0}

vars_simples <- E4_D4 %>% 
  select(sexe:issu, diag_avt:decede) %>% 
  colnames()

vars_txt <- E4_D4 %>% 
  select(prenom_conjt, prenom) %>% 
  colnames()

vars_adp <- E4_D4 %>% 
  select(adpt_mois, adpt_an) %>% 
  colnames()

vars_dcd <- E4_D4 %>% 
  select(decd_mois:decd_an) %>% 
  colnames()

E4_E0 <- E4_D4 %>% 
  rcdSM_vars_simple1(all_of(vars_simples)) %>% 
  rcdSM_txt_simple1(all_of(vars_txt)) %>% 
  rcdSM_vars_borne_opt1(issu, 4, all_of(vars_adp)) %>% 
  rcdSM_vars_borne_opt1(decede, 1, all_of(vars_dcd))

rm(list = c("vars_txt", "vars_simples", "vars_dcd", "vars_adp",
            "rcdSM_txt_simple1", "rcdSM_vars_borne_opt1", "rcdSM_vars_simple1"))

```

## Pivoter

```{r E4_E0 to E4_F0}

vars_wider <- E4_E0 %>% 
  select(prenom_conjt:decd_an) %>% 
  colnames()

E4_F0 <- E4_E0 %>% 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = rang_enf,
    values_from = all_of(vars_wider),
    names_glue = "{rang_enf}{.value}"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    across(
      starts_with("fa_enf") & where(is.character), ~ replace_when(
        .x, is.na(.x) ~ "-7"
      )
    ),
    across(
      starts_with("fa_enf") & where(is.numeric), ~ replace_when(
        .x, is.na(.x) ~ -7
      )
    )
  )

```

## Value labels autre


```{r E4_G0 to }

source("Muco_2026/Fonctions/rcd_mois.R")
source("Muco_2026/Fonctions/lbl_precis_SM.R")
```

## Ajouter étiquette des variables


```{r}

source("Muco_2026/Fonctions/etiquettes_repeted.R")
source("Muco_2026/Fonctions/etiquettes_repeted_regex.R")

E4_G2 <- E4_G1 %>% 
  set_variable_labels(
    id_anonymat = "Respondent unique identifier",
    fa_en_nb_enfants = "No. of children per resp.",
    fa_en_date_creation = "Children module completion date"
  ) %>% 
    etiquettes_repeted(., "prenom_conjt", "F14 Child ", " other parent's name") %>% 
    etiquettes_repeted(., "prenom", "F15 Child ", " name") %>% 
    etiquettes_repeted_regex(., "\\d_sexe$", "F16 Children ", " sex") %>% 
    etiquettes_repeted(., "_nais_mois", "F17 Child ", " DOB (month)") %>% 
    etiquettes_repeted(., "_nais_an", "F17 Child ", " DOB (year)") %>% 
    etiquettes_repeted(., "_issu", "F18 How child ", " joined the family") %>% 
    etiquettes_repeted(., "adpt_mois", "F19 Child ", " date of adoption (month)") %>% 
    etiquettes_repeted(., "adpt_an", "F19 Child ", " date of adoption (year)") %>% 
    etiquettes_repeted(., "diag_avt", "F20 Child ", " prenatal CF diagnosis") %>% 
    etiquettes_repeted(., "_muco", "F21 Child ", " has/had CF") %>% 
    etiquettes_repeted(., "_decede", "F22 Child ", " deceased") %>% 
    etiquettes_repeted(., "decd_mois", "F23 Child ", " date of death (month)") %>% 
    etiquettes_repeted(., "decd_an", "F23 Child ", " date of death (year)")

```
